shots.scene: 欣欣站在一个发光的空白刻度表前，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands next to a large glowing blank gauge dial and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课，我们来认识辐射剂量。
overlay: 辐射剂量（第1部分）：辐射防护

shots.scene: 方块、人体、骰子三个图标排成一行
shots.prompt_en: Three icons in a row: a cube, a human body outline and a dice. No people.
shots.narration: 吸收剂量、当量剂量，还有两类效应。

shots.scene: 小研拿到一张空白剂量报告单，阿杰凑过来看
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student holds a blank dose report sheet while the young male student leans in to look.
shots.narration: 小研收到了个人剂量报告。

shots.scene: 阿杰指着报告单上的两个空白格，头顶问号
shots.prompt_en: The young male student points at two blank boxes on the report, with a question mark above his head.
shots.narration: 阿杰问：戈瑞和希沃特，有啥不一样？

shots.scene: 欣欣从报告单后面探出头，竖起手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot pops up from behind the report sheet and raises one finger.
shots.narration: 别急，我们一个一个说。

shots.scene: 黄色辐射源方块向一个人体轮廓发出光点
shots.prompt_en: A yellow cube with an ionizing radiation symbol sends glowing dots toward a human body outline. No people.
shots.narration: 人受到照射，用剂量来衡量受了多少。

shots.scene: 剂量两字前面换上三块不同颜色的空白牌子
shots.prompt_en: Three blank colored tags slide in front of a dose icon one after another. No people.
shots.narration: 剂量前面常加吸收、当量、有效等词。

shots.scene: 一侧是能量闪电图标，一侧是人体损伤图标
shots.prompt_en: A lightning energy icon on one side and a body damage icon on the other side. No people.
shots.narration: 说的是沉积的能量，还是对人的损伤。

shots.scene: 辐射源方块照射一块小金属块，旁边空白天平显示一千克
shots.prompt_en: A radiation source cube shines on a small block resting on a blank scale. No people.
shots.narration: 最基本的是吸收剂量。

shots.scene: 光点钻进物块，物块微微发光
shots.prompt_en: Glowing dots enter the block and it glows faintly. No people.
shots.narration: 就是单位质量物质吸收的辐射能量。

shots.scene: 一千克物块上方一个焦耳能量图标，旁边戈瑞图标
shots.prompt_en: An energy icon above a one-kilogram block, next to a unit badge icon. No people.
shots.narration: 每千克吸收一焦耳，就是一戈瑞。

shots.section_title: 剂量按质量算，不按体积算
shots.scene: 欣欣站在一个巨大的透明空气立方体旁，脚边是小水块和更小的玻璃块
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a huge transparent cube of air, with a small cube of water and an even smaller glass cube at its feet.
shots.narration: 同样一千克，三种东西大小差很多。
overlay: 剂量按质量算，不按体积算

shots.section_title: 剂量按质量算，不按体积算
shots.scene: 三个立方体放在三台空白天平上，指针一样
shots.prompt_en: The three cubes sit on three blank scales whose needles point to the same position. No people.
shots.narration: 空气最轻最占地，玻璃最密最小。

shots.section_title: 剂量按质量算，不按体积算
shots.scene: 三个立方体同时被照射，上方三个绿勾
shots.prompt_en: The three cubes are irradiated at the same time, with three green checks above them. No people.
shots.narration: 质量一样、能量一样，剂量就一样。

shots.scene: 一个大立方体被分成空气、水、玻璃三段等体积
shots.prompt_en: A column of three equal-volume blocks stacked together: air, water and glass. No people.
shots.narration: 反过来，三种材料体积一样大。

shots.scene: 每段都吸收一个相同的能量图标
shots.prompt_en: Each block receives the same small energy icon. No people.
shots.narration: 各自吸收同样多的能量。

shots.scene: 三段旁边亮起高、中、低三个读数条
shots.prompt_en: Three reading bars appear beside the blocks: very high for air, medium for water, low for glass. No people.
shots.narration: 质量不同，剂量就差得很远。

shots.scene: 三个一千克立方体旁各立一支红色温度计
shots.prompt_en: Three one-kilogram cubes each with a red thermometer standing beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 同样剂量，对不同材料效果也不同。

shots.scene: 三支温度计升高的幅度不同，水的最低
shots.prompt_en: The three thermometers rise by different amounts; the one by the water cube rises the least. No people.
shots.narration: 同吸收1000戈瑞，水升温最少。

shots.scene: 欣欣看着温度计耸肩
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot looks at a thermometer that barely moves and shrugs.
shots.narration: 这么大的剂量，温度才升一点点。

shots.section_title: 对人体，怕的是细胞和基因损伤
shots.scene: 一群蓝色公众图标和一群红色工作人员图标
shots.prompt_en: A group of blue people icons for the public and a group of red people icons for radiation workers. No people.
shots.narration: 在剂量限值这个量级，怕的不是发热。
overlay: 对人体，怕的是细胞和基因损伤

shots.section_title: 对人体，怕的是细胞和基因损伤
shots.scene: 细胞和DNA图标上出现小裂痕
shots.prompt_en: Small cracks appear on a cell icon and a DNA icon. No people.
shots.narration: 而是细胞和基因受到损伤。

shots.section_title: 对人体，怕的是细胞和基因损伤
shots.scene: 癌细胞、婴儿、家族树三个图标，旁边黄色警示
shots.prompt_en: Icons of an abnormal cell, a baby and a family tree with yellow warning marks. No people.
shots.narration: 可能增加早亡风险：癌症、出生缺陷。

shots.section_title: 射线种类不同，伤害不同
shots.scene: α、β、γ三种射线的箭头图标
shots.prompt_en: Three arrow icons for alpha, beta and gamma rays in different colors. No people.
shots.narration: 伤害多大，还要看是哪种射线。
overlay: 射线种类不同，伤害不同

shots.section_title: 射线种类不同，伤害不同
shots.scene: 一个粗短的α箭头在很短距离内密集打出火花
shots.prompt_en: A short thick alpha arrow makes a dense cluster of sparks over a very short distance. No people.
shots.narration: α粒子电离强，在很短距离里放出能量。

shots.section_title: 射线种类不同，伤害不同
shots.scene: 一条细长的γ箭头稀疏地打出几个火花
shots.prompt_en: A long thin gamma arrow makes only a few sparse sparks along its path. No people.
shots.narration: γ射线一路上沉积的能量稀疏得多。

shots.section_title: 射线种类不同，伤害不同
shots.scene: DNA双螺旋：α一侧断得多，γ一侧断得少
shots.prompt_en: A DNA double helix: the side hit by alpha shows many breaks, the side hit by gamma shows few. No people.
shots.narration: 同样一戈瑞，α的伤害约是γ的20倍。

shots.section_title: 当量剂量与辐射权重因子
shots.scene: 欣欣举着一个乘号牌
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a big multiplication sign card.
shots.narration: 所以要引入当量剂量。
overlay: 当量剂量与辐射权重因子

shots.section_title: 当量剂量与辐射权重因子
shots.scene: 公式图标：方块乘以一个权重砝码，等于人体图标
shots.prompt_en: A formula made of icons: a cube times a weight block equals a human body outline. No people.
shots.narration: 吸收剂量乘以辐射权重因子。

shots.section_title: 当量剂量与辐射权重因子
shots.scene: 四种射线图标各配一个大小不同的砝码
shots.prompt_en: Four ray icons, each with a weight block of a different size; the alpha weight is by far the biggest. No people.
shots.narration: 光子电子最小，质子稍大，α最大。

shots.section_title: 当量剂量与辐射权重因子
shots.scene: 中子图标旁的砝码在变大变小
shots.prompt_en: A neutron icon beside a weight block that keeps changing size. No people.
shots.narration: 中子的权重，随能量变化。

shots.scene: 希沃特单位图标亮起
shots.prompt_en: A unit badge icon lights up next to a human body outline. No people.
shots.narration: 当量剂量的单位是希沃特。

shots.scene: γ和β各一戈瑞，与α的一小块，都换成同样大小的希沃特方块
shots.prompt_en: One gray block of gamma and one of beta, and a tiny block of alpha, each turn into equal-sized blocks. No people.
shots.narration: 一戈瑞γ或β，等于α的二十分之一。

shots.scene: 阿杰恍然大悟，在空白报告单上画了个勾
shots.prompt_en: The young male student's face lights up and he ticks a box on the blank report sheet.
shots.narration: 阿杰明白了：希沃特考虑了伤害大小。

shots.scene: 一个人体模型站在平台上，旁边空白图板
shots.prompt_en: A simple mannequin icon stands on a platform beside a blank chart board. No people.
shots.narration: 当量剂量用于较低剂量的风险。

shots.scene: 一大群人图标，随机几处亮起，旁边骰子
shots.prompt_en: A large crowd of people icons with a few lighting up at random, next to a dice icon. No people.
shots.narration: 这类效应随机发生，叫随机性效应。

shots.scene: 两组人群对比，受照组亮起的稍多一点
shots.prompt_en: Two crowds compared side by side; the exposed crowd has slightly more lit-up icons. No people.
shots.narration: 受照的人，发生概率比没受照的略高。

shots.scene: 一道门槛线，剂量箭头越过门槛
shots.prompt_en: A dose arrow climbs over a threshold bar. No people.
shots.narration: 急性大剂量，会出现确定性效应。

shots.scene: 皮肤发红、不育、眼睛浑浊三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: reddened skin, a crossed fertility symbol and a clouded eye. No people.
shots.narration: 比如皮肤红斑、不育、白内障。

shots.scene: 细胞成片受损的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a patch of many damaged cells. No people.
shots.narration: 它是细胞大量受损的直接结果。

shots.scene: 空白剂量报告和受损细胞图标之间画一个叉
shots.prompt_en: A blank dose report icon and a damaged cell icon with a red X between them. No people.
shots.narration: 这时不能用当量剂量来衡量。

shots.scene: 坐标图上一条S形曲线慢慢画出
shots.prompt_en: An S-shaped curve is slowly drawn on a graph. No people.
shots.narration: 急性照射的反应，常是一条S形曲线。

shots.scene: 曲线左段贴着横轴，标阈值点
shots.prompt_en: The left part of the curve stays flat on the axis, with a threshold point marked. No people.
shots.narration: 低于阈值，不出现效应。

shots.scene: 曲线右端到顶，一排人图标全部变色
shots.prompt_en: The right end of the curve reaches the top, and a row of people icons all change color. No people.
shots.narration: 剂量高到一定程度，人人都会出现症状。

shots.scene: 欣欣指着一扇写着下集的空白门
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points to a blank door with a next arrow icon on it.
shots.narration: 有效剂量，我们下一集再讲。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现一千克方块和焦耳图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a one-kilogram block and an energy bolt.
shots.narration: 吸收剂量看每千克吸收多少能量。

shots.scene: 方块乘砝码等于人体图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon formula: a cube times a weight block equals a human body outline. No people.
shots.narration: 乘上权重因子，就是当量剂量。

shots.scene: 骰子图标和门槛图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a dice and a threshold bar. No people.
shots.narration: 低剂量看概率，高剂量过门槛。

shots.scene: 粗短的α箭头和细长的γ箭头并排
shots.prompt_en: A short thick alpha arrow beside a long thin gamma arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 同一戈瑞，α的伤害约是γ的20倍。

shots.scene: 阿杰把空白报告单递给小研，两人点头
shots.prompt_en: The young male student hands the blank dose report back to the female graduate student and they both nod.
shots.narration: 阿杰终于看懂了剂量报告。

shots.scene: 欣欣挥手道别，身后空白刻度表
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye at the camera in front of a blank gauge dial.
shots.narration: 有效剂量，下集见！
